mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy shift that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate indicates a strengthening labor market, which typically supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where UNRATE declines by at least 0.1 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 thousand units in the prior month, it signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST exceeds 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger a monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and the unemployment rate indicates a coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus, which significantly boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of instances (i.e., when both series decline by at least 0.1 percentage points in the prior month).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where both HOUST and INDPRO increase by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0% and increasing for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as higher rates pressure equity valuations, leading to negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and FEDFUNDS rising for 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months during a monetary tightening cycle (defined as FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and rising for 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a strong gain in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs signals robust economic growth that supports equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS increases by at least 200,000 jobs.
